shared_elements: human figure in profile with long beard and elaborate headdress/hair
low-relief carved figures on a flat ground
stylized tree/plant with repeated leaf or palmette forms
figure with arm raised/extended toward a plant or object
figures shown with profile head and frontal-shouldered torso
justification: Both surfaces depict bearded male figures in strict profile with patterned hair/beard, long fringed robes and outstretched arms, and both include a conventionalized tree/plant standing beside a figure, rendered in the same shallow-relief, contour-with-incised-detail manner. The biggest difference in content is organisation and subject: A is a multi-register procession of many small repeated figures, animals and offerings, while B is a single monumental winged figure holding a bucket-and-cone-like attribute at a palmette tree, a motif absent from A.
